propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the reconciliation procedure and assembled the monthly control evidence pack for internal audit.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the procedure and evidence pack directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate agreed the monthly close timetable with treasury and credit operations and recorded who owned which entries.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the timetable coordination and the recorded boundaries.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate led the month-end disbursement reconciliation close as the registered control owner and approved adjustments within a delegated limit of 25,000.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the control register entry, the adjustment log and the reference all state the ownership and the delegated limit.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions at each month-end are only partly documented in the close-out checklist.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: control owner and approvals within the 25,000 limit; do not extend it to adjustments above the limit, which went to the finance controller.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded at each month-end.
